gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-comme: Tall, commanding, split by slivers of paper: that's Wallpoet up top. Comme, plain sans through and through, flows with no clogged curves, its lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height, so paragraphs glide.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-cossette-texte: Tall, gapped, unmistakable: Wallpoet takes the top line with a smooth path round every bend. Cossette Texte, plain sans with wide-eyed e shapes and a prominent x-height, gives it a tube-smooth partner underneath.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-hind-guntur: Tall, gapped letters punch up top in Wallpoet, each curve gliding round smoothly, while Hind Guntur below stays a single-weight sans-serif line. Wide gaps at the curve ends keep paragraphs easy going.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-huninn: Huninn is plain sans with lowercase rising close to cap height. Wallpoet above it is tall and gapped with smooth bends, while Huninn's crossbars stay as fat as their stems.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-krub: Krub is sans with a pronounced x-height and contemporary feel. What stands out most is the gulf between Wallpoet, tall and split by slivers of paper, and Krub's pen-lifted, open-looped curves.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Commanding, gap-lined Wallpoet towers over Mochiy Pop One, whose very large lowercase eyes hang like clothespins in plain sans rows. One stroke width, no calligraphic swell, keeps lines moving.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Mochiy Pop P One is a sans with a sizable lowercase body and wide stretches of blank space between letters. Wallpoet makes a loud, tall entrance; the body keeps one constant line.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-montserrat-underline: Montserrat Underline is sans with oversized lowercase and breathing counters. Wallpoet's tall, gap-split letters command the top, then Montserrat Underline follows with round bowls whose walls never swell anywhere.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-mozilla-headline: Tall, gap-split Wallpoet commands the top line, while Mozilla Headline fills the rest with big-bodied lowercase in plain sans form. Its splayed c terminals keep longer paragraphs feeling lively.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-nata-sans: Wide-mouthed curves and a large central band make the body text read steady and clean. Nata Sans, plain sans with no curve stress, set against Wallpoet's tall gapped letters, makes sheer contrast the standout.
